about: Hand-written coach replies for the Jev gold set: cases the eval personas rarely produce, such as people sharing customer or suspect details, and tricky edges of the other checks. Everything here is fictional: the team is the sample fraud strategy and analytics team, every customer and suspect name is invented, and every phone, ID, account and device number starts with 00 (after any country code) so it cannot be real. npm run jev:label labels these with the eval replies. The note on each item says what it is meant to test, for people reading the file; the labels come from Opus and from people, never from the note.
